pub type Raw
pub enum PageOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Unavailable
  InvalidRequest
  RecordTooLarge
  Corrupt
  Unsupported
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum HistoryPageOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Unavailable
  Invalid
  RecordTooLarge
  Corrupt
  Unsupported
  Forbidden
  NotPermitted
  OsAuthorizationRequired
  OsAuthorizationPending
  pub const ALL: [Self; 11]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ApplicationLogSelection
  OneApp
  AllApps
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum SourceAvailability
  Available
  PermissionDenied
  Unavailable
  Unsupported
  pub const ALL: [Self; 4]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>

  pub const RETENTION: &str

  pub const COLLECTION_POLICY: &str
  pub const NATIVE_ACCESS: &str
  pub const VISIBILITY_UNKNOWN: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 5]

  Catalog
  Forbidden
  NotPermitted
  Unavailable
  Invalid
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]

pub struct Attestation
  by: String
  verified: bool
  hop: i64
  program: String
  host: String
  user: String
  exe: String
  uid: i64
  gid: i64
  pid: i64
  key: String
  mac: String
pub struct Record
  schema: i64
  time: String
  level: i64
  msg: String
  identity: Vec<Attestation>
  job: String
  attrs: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub struct Page
  outcome: PageOutcome
  records: Vec<Record>
  next: String
  at_end: bool
pub struct ApplicationLogTarget
  selection: ApplicationLogSelection
  program: String
pub struct ApplicationLogResource
  program: String
  captured_file_key: String
pub struct ApplicationLogPage
  outcome: HistoryPageOutcome
  records: Vec<Record>
  next: String
  at_end: bool
pub struct SourceDescriptor
  id: String
  availability: SourceAvailability
  limitations: Vec<String>
pub struct SourceCatalog
  sources: Vec<SourceDescriptor>
  outcome: SourceCatalogOutcome
pub struct ProducerClaim
  provider: String
  program: String
  exe: String
  user: String
  pid: i64
  uid: i64
  gid: i64
pub struct SourceRecord
  source_id: String
  record: Record
  producer: Option<ProducerClaim>
pub struct SourcePage
  outcome: HistoryPageOutcome
  records: Vec<SourceRecord>
  next: String
  at_end: bool
pub fn encode(v: &Record) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Record, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Sink
  type Error
  fn write(&self, record: Record) -> Result<(), Self::Error>
pub struct SinkClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait HistoryReader
  type Error
  fn read(&self, cursor: String, max_records: i64, max_bytes: i64) -> Result<Page, Self::Error>
pub struct HistoryReaderClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait HistoryObserver
  type Error
  fn observe(&self, cursor: String, max_records: i64, max_bytes: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<Page, Self::Error>

  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T

  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T

  type Error
  fn sources(&self) -> Result<SourceCatalog, Self::Error>
